lines.speaker: li
lines.text: The distress call stopped the moment the last husk went dark.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Nobody in the shafts. No bodies either. They must have evacuated.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: But Moss, you're going to want to see hangar four. There's a rig in here. Like a docking cradle, but... nicer.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Nicer is an understatement. Look at the couplings. No bolts, no clamp teeth. The surfaces just... meet.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: This is Ashfall's prototype. It has to be. A hull-graft rig. It fuses two ships into one: no drift, no stress, no thrust penalty. None of the junk our clamps give us.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: Ashfall was a mining outpost. Where did they get the money for a miracle?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Miners are cleverer than pilots, Hollis. Everyone knows that.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: No maker's stamp anywhere. And the housing is warm. It's running on its own power.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Hand-built and self-heating. Like I said: miracle.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: If it works, Kestrel and Tern could become one ship. Hollis?

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: Tern always wanted a bigger home.
